assumptions.choice: The 1% risk cap is computed against current portfolio value (self.broker.getvalue()) at the time of entry, not the fixed initial cash.
assumptions.reason: Spec says 'does not exceed 1% of capital' without specifying fixed vs. current equity; current equity is the standard percent-risk sizing convention.

assumptions.choice: Both the risk-per-share denominator and the +2% take-profit target use the close price of the breakout bar (the bar that triggers the buy), not the actual next-bar fill price.
assumptions.reason: Backtrader fills market orders at the next bar's open, so the real fill price is unknown when size must be computed; using the breakout close keeps sizing and the take-profit target self-consistent and matches the spec's close-based framing of the breakout event.

assumptions.choice: Position size is floored to an integer number of shares.
assumptions.reason: Fractional shares are not applicable to this instrument; flooring guarantees realized risk never exceeds the 1% cap.

assumptions.choice: Interpreted as the 3 bars immediately preceding the breakout bar (offsets -1, -2, -3).
assumptions.reason: The breakout bar itself closes above the band by definition, so it cannot be one of the 'on/below' candles; the filter must reference the prior 3 bars.

assumptions.choice: Stop-loss and take-profit are evaluated against each bar's close price rather than intrabar high/low.
assumptions.reason: The spec defines entry and stop-loss purely in terms of 'close above/below the band,' so close-based evaluation is applied consistently to the take-profit rule as well.
